```{r setup}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```


```{r pressure}
species<-read.csv("species.csv")
species
library(AICcmodavg)
poisson0 <- glm(Species ~ 1, data = species, family = poisson (link="log"))
poisson1 <- glm(Species ~ pH + Biomass, data = species, family = poisson (link="log"))
poisson2 <- glm(Species ~ pH, data = species, family = poisson (link="log"))
poisson3 <- glm(Species ~ Biomass, data = species, family = poisson (link="log"))
candidate_models <- list (poisson1, poisson2, poisson3)
model_names <- c("pHBio", "pH", "Biomass")
aicc_table <- aictab(cand.set = candidate_models, modnames = model_names)
print(aicc_table)
summary(poisson1)
#lower biomass and Mid-Low pH are correlated with a higher number of species
``` 

```{r}
bolger<-read.csv("bolger.csv")
bolger
logistic0 <- glm(RODENTSP ~ 1, data = bolger, family = binomial)
logistic1 <- glm(RODENTSP ~ PERSHRUB + DISTX + AGE, data = bolger, family = binomial)
logistic2 <- glm(RODENTSP ~ PERSHRUB, data = bolger, family = binomial)
logistic3 <- glm(RODENTSP ~ DISTX, data = bolger, family = binomial)
logistic4 <- glm(RODENTSP ~ AGE, data = bolger, family = binomial)
logistic5 <- glm(RODENTSP ~ DISTX + AGE, data = bolger, family = binomial)
logistic6 <- glm(RODENTSP ~ PERSHRUB + DISTX, data = bolger, family = binomial)
logistic7 <- glm(RODENTSP ~ PERSHRUB + AGE, data = bolger, family = binomial)
candidate_models <- list (logistic1, logistic2, logistic3, logistic4, logistic5, logistic6, logistic7)
model_names <- c("%shrubdistage", "%shrub", "dist", "age", "distage", "%shrubdist", "%shrubage")
aicc_table <- aictab(cand.set = candidate_models, modnames = model_names)
print(aicc_table)
summary(logistic2)
#percentage of shrub coverage is associated with the presence of rodents
```


```{r}
molerat<-read.csv("molerat.csv")
molerat
gamma0 <- glm(lnenergy ~ 1, data = molerat, family = Gamma(link=log))
gamma1 <- glm(lnenergy ~ lnmass + caste, data = molerat, family = Gamma(link=log))
gamma2 <- glm(lnenergy ~ lnmass, data = molerat, family = Gamma(link=log))
gamma3 <- glm(lnenergy ~ caste, data = molerat, family = Gamma(link=log))
candidate_models <- list (gamma1, gamma2, gamma3)
model_names <- c("masscaste", "mass", "caste")
aicc_table <- aictab(cand.set = candidate_models, modnames = model_names)
print(aicc_table)
summary(gamma1)
#higher masses (higher relative significance) and worker caste are correlated with higher energy expenditure
```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.
